notes.title: Horror Update - New Features
notes.content:
🎃 Horror Update 🎃

A whole slew of new features which enhance the game. With valuable feedback from our community, we've made changes to enhance your horror experience. Check out the latest updates below!
Want more content? show support and review the game!

    Chainsaw Killer Upgrade – We’ve re-tuned the AI for a scarier, more challenging encounter. Now, the Chainsaw Killer is faster, more aggressive, and follows improved patrol routes, while sound enhancements help you sense his approach with dread!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45242273/8980b74b0866344e9655c035c716e9140716b4f8.jpg

    New Gather Areas + Checkpoints – Players will need to gather together at the begginning of an attraction to unlock the gate to enter. This reinforces coop play and makes it more Fun! 
Furthermore, Checkpoints for wounded/fallen players will teleport and heal them as soon as healthy players finish the attraction area. This reduces downtime.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45242273/75071644714624e928af5f80415fb1e52c24f1a9.jpg

    Randomized Objectives – Now each play through offers fresh challenges as objectives and items pickups are randomized and appear in new locations, enhancing replayability and keeping you on edge!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45242273/2343fc1e23f7bbd167d28858404bd0c15088aaec.jpg

    Achievements Added – For all the achievement hunters, your rewards await.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45242273/c5aa2f97cc935dcfb4e24af88436f7319b03d0b7.jpg

    Revive Teammates – Now, you can personally revive your teammates with a med kit, keeping the action fast-paced and your squad together. Previously, you had to drop the kit for them to heal themselves, but now you can handle the healing directly, adding a new level of teamwork to the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45242273/86ea4f54219e40131af6c7cb8dbdfce880610a02.jpg

    Various Bug Fixes – Plus, we’ve resolved over 50 bugs for a smoother and more immersive experience.

    Optimization Pass – The Farm Map gets an optimization pass to further add performance in order to support more specs. Plus smoother game play is funner!


We hope you enjoy the update, don't forget to share with your fellow horror fans! 🕷️

Get your friends to play with the Halloween Discount Bundle Below!

notes.title: New Map Haunted Forest Incoming!
notes.content:
🎃 New Haunted Forest Map - Coming Soon!🎃

We're excited to announce the New Haunted Forest map, featuring an entirely new area, along with fresh objectives, challenging puzzles, and terrifying new enemies like Werewolves and Witches!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45242273/d0e245400ac5fbeacfaad0102b7c8f957d964ff8.jpg

In this latest Haunted Attraction, you and your team venture into a forest village abandoned long ago. Navigate carefully, as dark forces now roam under the full moon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45242273/eb28d7d3522f06521c19891c76923671fe2477af.jpg

Pushed further into the woods, you’ll find lurking werewolves blocking your path. Sneak by them without raising alarm, and rely on each other to survive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45242273/82fbd6678503c1f2f8e6d504b466e789bef956a7.jpg

Finally, reach the Witch’s Hut deep in the forest. This sinister figure is the source of the evil spreading through the land. Stopping her may be your only hope.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45242273/99fd7885c3b4c6fdb6924f3b133eed6a4f03bca1.jpg
